brief: A contacts app as a social constellation — closeness reflects relationship, interactions glow

dominant_strengths: Strong conceptual metaphor: 'ME' as gravitational center with orbiting contacts feels novel and emotionally legible
Pastel avatar palette against deep navy creates pleasant luminosity, evoking the constellation theme well
Stats panel and sidebar share consistent rounded geometry, giving the system a cohesive visual grammar
dominant_weaknesses: Constellation positions appear arbitrary — closeness doesn't visibly map to relationship tier (Family is far, Acquaintance is close)
No visible 'glow' or interaction trails despite the brief promising interactions glow; canvas feels static and underdesigned
Massive empty negative space with sparse nodes wastes the canvas; orbital rings or connection lines would clarify hierarchy
fix_priorities: Encode relationship tier into radial distance and add concentric orbit guides so the metaphor becomes literal
Add glow halos, pulse animation, and connection lines for active/recent interactions to fulfill the core brief
Tighten spatial composition — reduce dead space, balance node distribution around ME with intentional clusters
Refine typography hierarchy on node labels (currently uniform) to differentiate close vs distant contacts
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral charm and reflective concept lead, but behavioral utility lags because spatial encoding doesn't actually communicate relationship data.
rationale.intent_fit: The constellation metaphor is present visually but only half-delivered — closeness isn't meaningfully encoded and interactions don't glow.
